request.system:
Decide whether a sentence is fully supported by the quoted source texts and computed values given. Supported means
every claim in the sentence is stated in a quote or equals a provided computed value. Wording can differ; meaning
cannot. Anything extra, stronger, or interpretive is unsupported. Return only the tool call.
request.user:
SENTENCE: Revenue rose from $980,000,000 in the fiscal year ended 2025-06-30 to $1,250,000,000 in the fiscal year ended 2026-06-30.
QUOTES: []
COMPUTED: ["m:revenue:2025-06-30: {\"name\": \"revenue\", \"period_end\": \"2025-06-30\", \"unit\": \"usd\", \"value\": \"980000000\"}", "m:revenue:2026-06-30: {\"name\": \"revenue\", \"period_end\": \"2026-06-30\", \"unit\": \"usd\", \"value\": \"1250000000\"}", "revenue from 2025-06-30 to 2026-06-30: difference 270000000, change 0.2755, ratio 1.2755"]

content.reason: The sentence's two figures match the computed values exactly: revenue of 980,000,000 for period_end 2025-06-30 and 1,250,000,000 for period_end 2026-06-30, both in USD. The computed change (difference 270,000,000, ratio 1.2755) confirms the direction of movement is upward, so "rose from ... to ..." is supported.
